behaviour_summary: pi0 pushes the open destination drawer part-way shut (60-160), pulls it open again (200-300), dips toward the bowl/drawer front at 300-320, then lifts the arm up and away (340-409). No butter is touched.
runs_trained_task: libero_10 KITCHEN_SCENE4 'put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it' (drawer close/open cycle near the bowl); medium-low confidence

failures.mode_definition: pi0 runs the scene's habitual/trained-task behaviour instead of the instructed one, approaching a non-target object or fixture (and may destroy a precondition).
failures.hl_remedy: HALT -> RETREAT(up 10 cm, 5 cm away from cabinet) -> VERIFY(top drawer open); if closed INSERT_SUBTASK 'open the top drawer of the cabinet' -> REPROMPT 'pick up the butter at the back and place it in the top drawer of the cabinet' -> WATCH 5 s for an approach to the back butter -> VERIFY(butter in drawer) -> REPROMPT 'close the top drawer of the cabinet'; retry once with a 15 cm retreat, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Declare 'top drawer open' as a protected state until the butter is inside; HALT on the first violation or when the empty gripper heads for the drawer.
failures.observation: Step 40: gripper over the table moving toward the cabinet. 60-80: on the drawer front; 120-160: drawer partly closed (not flush). 200-240: gripper at the top handle, drawer pulled back out; fully open by 300. 300-320: hand over the bowl / drawer front. 340-409: arm raised out of view. Butters untouched; drawer ends fully open and empty.

notes: The partial (non-flush) close at 120-160 resembles LL-1 but is not recorded, since the close itself was not instructed at that point.
